name: trading-system-review
description: Fresh-eyes senior-trader review of an existing algorithmic trading system: re-runs the backtest, computes deflated Sharpe / PBO / Monte Carlo / regime stats with a bundled script, researches today's market and new techniques on the web (CloakBrowser fallback), scores a 10-dimension rubric with hard gates, and renders an offline HTML report with charts and a deploy / incubate / revamp / retire verdict. Delegates through the orchestrate skill.
